description: jQuery plugin for fixing PNG transparency issues in older versions of Internet Explorer, including functions to apply and remove PNG hacks and position fixes.

methods.name: $.ifixpng
methods.description: Sets a custom pixel image for PNG fix.

methods.name: $.ifixpng.getPixel
methods.description: Retrieves the current pixel image used for PNG fix, defaults to 'images/pixel.gif'.

methods.name: $.fn.ifixpng
methods.description: Applies PNG fix hack to selected elements if IE version is less than 7.

methods.name: $.fn.iunfixpng
methods.description: Removes PNG fix hack from selected elements if IE version is less than 7.

methods.name: $.fn.positionFix
methods.description: Positions elements relatively if they are not already positioned as absolute or relative.
